answer.reason: The verses only name Mica in genealogies and a list of signers, saying nothing of him beyond being an ancestor, which the summary already gives.
doubts: NEH 10:11 (Micha among the Levite signers) may be a different man of the same name.
2CH 20:14 does not name Mica; it names Mattaniah, an ancestor of Jahaziel, and is not about this record.
